step1_analysis.description: A switched-capacitor network used as a discrete-time loop filter in a phase-locked loop (PLL). It integrates the charge pump current onto a sampling capacitor (CS), shares the charge with a hold capacitor (CH) to update the VCO control voltage, and then resets the sampling capacitor, effectively creating a stabilization zero without requiring large resistors.

paper_reference.title: A Fast Switching PLL Frequency Synthesizer With an On-Chip Passive Discrete-Time Loop Filter in 0.25-m CMOS

voltage_step.description: The voltage change on the hold capacitor (VCH) after charge sharing.

sky130_expected.calculation: With I_pump = 100uA for 10ns, Q = 1pC. Initial VCP = 1pC / 20pF = 50mV. After sharing, VCH = Q / (CS + CH) = 1pC / 60pF = 16.67mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the charge conservation between CS and CH during the sharing phase.

charge_share_ratio.description: The ratio of the sampling capacitance to the total capacitance, determining the discrete-time zero location.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's reported capacitance values (20pF and 40pF) to achieve the desired loop dynamics.

settling_time.description: Time required for the charge sharing between CS and CH to settle within 1% of the final value.

sky130_expected.calculation: Time constant tau = R_on * (CS || CH). Assuming R_on = 10 ohms, tau = 10 * 13.3pF = 133ps. Settling time ~ 5 * tau = 665ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the ON-resistance of the switches used for charge sharing.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to verify the charge integration, charge sharing, and reset phases of the discrete-time loop filter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Discrete-Time Loop Filter Testbench

.param C_S=20p C_H=40p
.param I_pump=100u
.param T_pump=10n

* DUT (Adapted for ngspice valid switch syntax)
CS VCP GND {C_S}
CH VCH GND {C_H}
S1 VCP VCH ctrl1 GND sw_model
S2 VCP GND ctrl2 GND sw_model

* Switch Model
.model sw_model sw vt=0.9 vh=0.1 ron=10 roff=1G

* Stimulus
* 1. Charge pump current pulse (Integrate charge onto CS: 0 to 10ns)
I1 GND VCP PULSE(0 {I_pump} 1n 100p 100p {T_pump} 100n)

* 2. Switch 1 control (Charge share between CS and CH: 20ns to 30ns)
Vctrl1 ctrl1 GND PULSE(0 1.8 20n 100p 100p 10n 100n)

* 3. Switch 2 control (Reset CS to GND: 40ns to 50ns)
Vctrl2 ctrl2 GND PULSE(0 1.8 40n 100p 100p 10n 100n)

.control
* Run transient analysis
tran 100p 60n

* Measure peak voltage on CS after integration
meas tran v_vcp_peak max v(VCP) from=10n to=19n

* Measure final voltage on CH after charge sharing
meas tran v_vch_final find v(VCH) at=35n

* Measure reset voltage on CS after reset phase
meas tran v_vcp_reset find v(VCP) at=55n

* Calculate charge share ratio based on voltages
let charge_share_ratio = v_vch_final / v_vcp_peak
print charge_share_ratio

quit
.endc
.end
